name: Cloud Office Print - Document Generation from Google Drive + Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Document generation: template from Drive, data from Sheets

**Before running:** set your credential on every Cloud Office Print, Google Drive and Google Sheets node, one by one. n8n does not copy credentials across imported nodes. Then pick your own files in the empty File and Document fields.

Fills a Word invoice template with order lines from a spreadsheet and saves one PDF per customer back to Drive.

### Setup
1. Upload `docs/assets/templates/invoice-template.docx` to your Drive.
2. Import `docs/assets/data/order-lines.csv` into a Google Sheet, tab name `Order Lines`.
3. Select your credentials in the Cloud Office Print, Google Drive and Google Sheets nodes.
4. Select your copies of the file and the sheet.

## Trigger

Runs on demand.

For nightly invoicing use a Schedule Trigger instead, or a Google Sheets Trigger to run when a row is added.

## Get the template

Google Drive, operation Download File.

**Pick the file.** The File field is empty on import. Click it and choose `invoice-template.docx` from your Drive.

The file comes out as binary in the `data` field. Cloud Office Print needs Base64, so the next node converts it.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Download DOCX template from Drive

parameters.content:
## Binary to Base64

Extract from File, operation Move File to Base64 String.

Input Binary Field: `data`
Destination Output Field: `templateBase64`

Use this node whenever a file has to reach Cloud Office Print, whatever the source.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Template file as Base64
Get order lines from Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Get the data

Google Sheets, operation Get Row(s) in Sheet.

**Pick the spreadsheet.** The Document field is empty on import. Click it and choose your orders spreadsheet. Leave Sheet on `Order Lines`.

Columns: `cust_first_name`, `cust_last_name`, `cust_city`, `order_name`, `product_name`, `quantity`, `unit_price`.

Nine rows in the sample sheet, so nine items come out of this node.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Get order lines from Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Shape the data

Code node, mode Run Once for All Items.

Groups the flat rows into the nested structure the template tags expect and adds up `order_total`.

Returns one item per customer. Every node after this then runs once per customer, so no loop is needed.

## Generate the document

Resource Document Generation.

Base64 Encoded File: `{{ $('Template file as Base64').first().json.templateBase64 }}`. The template is the same for every customer, hence `.first()`.

Data (JSON): `{{ JSON.stringify($json.copData) }}`

Output Type: `pdf`. A docx template can also export to docx, html or txt.

The result comes back as Base64 in `body`.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Cloud Office Print - Generate document

parameters.content:
## Base64 to file

Convert to File, operation Move Base64 String to File.

Base64 Input Field: `body`
Put Output File in Field: `data`

Drive, S3 and mail nodes need real binary, not a string.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Base64 result to PDF file

parameters.content:
## Save the result

Google Drive, operation Upload File.

Input Data Field Name: `data`
File Name: `{{ $('Build document data').item.json.fileName }}.pdf`

`.item` follows the item that produced this one, so each customer gets the right name.

Replace this node with Dropbox, S3 or Gmail to deliver elsewhere.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Upload generated PDF to Drive
